Package index

Model selection

sdmTMB_selection()
Compare a set of sdmTMB model-selection candidates
selection_frame()
Complete-case frame for a set of model-selection candidates
best_candidate()
The best candidate in a selection table
add_aic_weights()
Add delta-AIC and Akaike weights to a comparison table
sdmTMB_cv_summary()
Summarise an sdmTMB cross-validation on a per-observation scale

Model and mesh comparison

compare_models()
Compare sdmTMB models
compare_meshes()
Compare survey indices across different mesh cutoff values
sdmTMB_mesh_cv()
Spatial cross-validation across mesh cutoff values

Retrospective analysis

sdmTMB_retro()
Retrospective analysis for an sdmTMB index
mohns_rho()
Mohn's rho for a set of index series

Survey comparison and prediction grids

compare_surveys()
Compare individual survey indices to a compiled sdmTMB index
make_survey_prediction_region()
Build a concave-hull prediction region from survey positions
make_prediction_grid()
Build a regular prediction grid over a region
